verdict.rationale: Setup is documented mainly as hand-editing librechat.yaml and .env files for providers, model settings and defaults. The browser-based Admin Panel can manage that same configuration, and MCP servers can be added at runtime from a settings panel without editing config. None of this is evidenced as a guided first-run wizard. Missing for 10: a guided first-run setup wizard, in-UI model credential entry during onboarding, channel configuration, and hands-on evidence of a no-config-file setup flow.
